description: Cross-reference mapping from sources.bib keys to report sections and experiments where cited

langdale2019simdjson.role: Primary inspiration — simdjson's structural character classification and CLMUL technique are the foundation of our SIMD parser

ge2019speculative.role: Speculative parallel CSV parsing — validates our chunked speculation approach; their >99.9% quote-parity assumption accuracy informed our parallel design

rfc4180.role: Defines the CSV grammar our parser implements — 5-state FSM with 25 transitions

barenghi2015parallel.role: Theoretical foundation for parallel parsing with speculative state resolution

fog2024microarchitecture.role: Micro-architectural analysis reference — branch misprediction penalties, IPC estimation methodology

koekkoek2024simdzone.role: SIMD parsing applied to DNS zone files — validates cross-domain applicability of structural classification

keiser2023ondemand.role: On-demand JSON parsing — demonstrates selective field extraction reducing materialization overhead

apachearrow2024.role: Primary baseline — Arrow's CSV reader is our strongest competitor at 769-1444 MB/s

gallant2018xsv.role: Rust-native CSV toolkit baseline — demonstrates scalar-optimized approach at 300-600 MB/s

langdale2019simdcsv.role: Direct predecessor — Langdale's simdcsv applies simdjson techniques to CSV; our implementation extends with speculative prediction

gueron2010pclmulqdq.role: PCLMULQDQ instruction reference — documents the carry-less multiplication instruction we use for prefix-XOR computation

wellons2021csvquote.role: Independent discovery of CLMUL-based quote pairing for CSV — validates our core technique

frigo1999cacheoblivious.role: Cache-oblivious algorithm theory — informs our 64KB block size choice for L2-friendly processing

head2009speculative.role: Speculative parallel XML parsing — analogous speculation-and-verify approach for structured text

borsotti2025parallel.role: Parallel regex parsing with speculation — extends the speculative parallel parsing paradigm to regular expressions

kornai1999vectorized.role: Early vectorized FSA work — theoretical foundation for SIMD-accelerated state machines

afroozeh2023fastlanes.role: FastLanes SIMD columnar processing — demonstrates transpose-free SIMD for column-oriented data

langdale2018smh.role: PSHUFB-based character classification from Hyperscan — alternative SIMD classification technique
